bets.label: Between
bets.description: Wins when the card falls strictly between the two dice, at odds set by the spread (high die minus low die). A pair or dice one apart push.

bets.label: Match
bets.description: Wins when the card equals either die.

bets.label: Bullseye
bets.description: Bull's eye: wins when the dice are two apart and the card is the value between.

pays.label: Both hands are the same pair

bets.label: Mirror
bets.description: Wins when your dice outrank the dealer's two cards. A pair beats any non-pair and a higher pair a lower one; between non-pairs the higher sum wins, then the higher value. Ties lose.

bets.label: Tie
bets.description: Wins when the two hands rank exactly equal: the same pair, or the same two values.

bets.label: Equal Sums
bets.description: Wins when the dice and the cards add up to the same total.

bets.label: Pair vs Pair
bets.description: Wins when both hands are pairs.

bets.label: Perfect Mirror
bets.description: Wins when both hands are the same pair.

paytable.label: Both hands are the same pair

bets.label: Double Sixes
bets.description: Wins when both hands are 6-6: 1000 to 1, plus a share of the progressive meter in proportion to the stake (the whole meter at the 25.00 maximum). 10% of every stake on this bet goes to the meter.

bets.label: Lock & Roll
bets.description: Wins 1 to 1 when your dice add up to more than the dealer's two cards; a tie loses. After the roll you may lock one die and roll the other once more, for the Lock fee of 40% of the bet, taken at once and never returned (a roll of 1-1 re-rolls for free).

decisions.description: After the roll: Stand, or Lock (keep one die and roll the other once more) for the Lock fee, 40% of the bet, taken at once and never returned; a roll of 1-1 re-rolls for free. A re-roll is always worth more with the higher die locked. The reference strategy re-rolls on 1-1, 2-1, 3-1, 4-1, 5-1, 6-1, 3-2, 4-2, 5-2 and stands on the other 12 rolls.

card.measure: net result per unit of the main bet, the fee included (Lock keeps the higher die)
